18    Helming to explain her vote.

19                 SENATOR HELMING:   Thank you, 

20    Mr. President.  

21                 We hear a lot of talk about 

22    affordability, including from our schools and 

23    taxpayers who are facing extreme cost increases.  

24    A lot of these cost increases are driven by state 

25    mandates from skyrocketing utilities, healthcare 


                                                                593

 1    and insurance costs, to the multi-billion-dollar 

 2    all-electric school bus mandate.  

 3                 Adding more mandates without 

 4    providing dedicated state funding will only 

 5    increase the burden on our schools and on our 

 6    constituents' tax bills.

 7                 Under the current budget proposal, 

 8    many districts are slated to receive just a 

 9    1 percent increase in Foundation Aid.  At the 

10    same time, they're facing double-digit cost 

11    increases outside of their control.

12                 We should be supporting increased 

13    school safety and the mandates should come with 

14    dedicated resources.

15                 I support several bills that would 

16    make school safety and security improvements 

17    eligible for additional state funding streams.  

18    Because if we expect schools to make significant 

19    investments while maintaining critical programs, 

20    the state must be a partner in that effort.  

21                 I encourage this body to take a look 

22    at our Republican Conference school safety plans 

23    and to bring these bills to the floor for a vote.

24                 Just this past Saturday I 

25    participated in the Monroe County School Board 


                                                                594

 1    Association legislative meeting.  There, there 

 2    were several students who spoke very powerfully 

 3    about the impact of unfunded mandates.  One young 

 4    man summed it up perfectly:  "If the state is 

 5    going to mandate it, the state should pay for 

 6    it."

 7                 Right now, schools and taxpayers 

 8    need relief.  We have better bills that achieve 

 9    the intended goal of the bill before us that 

10    won't squeeze the taxpayers.  For that reason, 

11    Mr. President, I vote no.

12                 ACTING PRESIDENT BAILEY:   Senator 

13    Helming to be recorded in the negative.
